title: Titans say Cam Ward's shoulder looks good, optimistic about return at June minicamp

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Titans say Cam Ward's shoulder looks good, optimistic about return at June minicamp
sources.description: Titans quarterback Cam Ward is making progress in recovering from the shoulder injury he suffered in the last game of last season, and he should be able to participate in the team's June minicamp.
